content: browser-use (Python) is agent-first: LLM reads page state and decides actions autonomously, no selectors, uses Playwright under the hood. Playwright MCP is precise/deterministic and snapshot-driven, meant as a pluggable tool layer for an existing agent framework (like Claude Code). For a Claude Code skill orchestrated by Claude itself, Playwright MCP is the natural fit since Claude is already the planning/reasoning agent; browser-use duplicates that reasoning loop in Python and adds an extra LLM-in-the-loop dependency.
